crop.notes: Clipping is only the closing paragraph at the top of column 6. The item's headline ('The Ring. Goss and Dwyer to Fight') and opening, at the bottom of column 5 on page 3, are missing.

ocr.notes: Key figures are wrong in the transcript: image reads fine of $250, 250 days, and $250 (OCR has $50, 50 days, $750).

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat noted that Joe Goss's last ring appearance was against Tom Allen in Kentucky, after which Goss was fined $250 and, unable to pay, imprisoned for 250 days.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, August 20, 1878, page 3.

facts.fact: After his fight with Allen in Kentucky, Joe Goss was arrested, fined $250 and, unable to pay, imprisoned for 250 days

notes: The item also says Goss's friends sent him the fine money halfway through his term but he kept it and served out the sentence. The opening paragraph (Goss-Dwyer match) is outside the clipping.
